title: Koi Bhi Mulk Ho Parcham Tera Lehraata Hai
body:
Koi bhi mulk ho parcham tera lehraata hai
Tu hai gaazi zamaane ko ye dikhlaata hai
Zikr jab tera zabaa par koi le aata hai
Tera alam ya Abbas
Uthaae ham ya Abbas
Karde karam ya Abbas
Mite alam ya Abbas
Karde karam ya Abbas
Ya Abbas ya Abbas
Saare aalam me yuhi gunje gi maatam ki sadaa
